decisions.reason: The candidate already requires one accounted ticket per primary mint and registration of randomly assigned no-referral tickets; its same-message MODIFY also captures surface consistency and historical backfill.
The existing same-message MODIFY already requires no-referral tickets and commissions to appear in NFT attributes, historical backfill, and matching ticket and commission counts.
The FAQ state already says that a no-referral mint assigns one Small Block ticket and its commission to a random existing NFT holder, and message 672 does not request a copy change.
Issuing one ticket for a no-referral mint does not change the Small Block draw amount, trigger, ticket window, reset behavior, or pool funding rules.
This candidate governs ticket issuance when a valid referral code is used; message 672 confirms that path is already accurate and changes only no-referral issuance.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures one $5 commission per primary mint, no-referral projection across required surfaces, historical backfill, and ticket-commission consistency.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records one $5 commission for every completed no-referral primary mint, while random recipient selection was already established.
Random assignment of a no-referral ticket concerns ticket allocation, not the Chainlink VRF method used to select prize winners from eligible tickets.
The no-referral ticket count does not change automatic prize delivery or reintroduce a claim interaction.
The ticket-allocation decision does not alter winner announcement, dashboard notification, or email notification behavior.
The source changes no-referral ticket issuance, not public prize-pool values or the next-draw sales counter.
Validation rules and feedback already distinguish valid codes from blank or invalid codes and already describe one randomly assigned ticket for the latter path.
